ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75-80% low-intensity (dark grey to black) to 20-25% high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels, with high-intensity regions concentrated along the trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally dominant low-intensity contiguous region. High-intensity mottling and irregular patches are localized in the distal quadrants, particularly concentrated on the left and right upper margins. A thin vertical higher-intensity column is visible at the lower junction of the lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with approximately a 35-degree interior angle and significant pixel-depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-15 pixels across the entire trailing boundary, creating a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep originating from the median notch, curving upwards and outwards toward distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, raised-intensity pixels (consistent with barnacle colonization) are visible at the leftmost and rightmost distal tips and at irregular intervals along the trailing edge serrations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent structural irregularities at both fluke tips due to dense localized barnacle colonization and associated tissue erosion.
